master_host.description: IP address or hostname the MFS master server listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

data_path.description: Directory where master metadata, logs, and transaction journal are stored. Must be writable by the 'mfs' user.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle chunkserver communication.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of file descriptors allowed per worker thread.

chunkserver_reconnect_interval.description: Seconds to wait before attempting to reconnect to a chunkserver after network failure.

access_log.description: Enable or disable logging of client access operations.

transaction_log.description: Enable or disable detailed transaction logging (required for metadata recovery).

statistics_log.description: Enable or disable periodic statistics logging (e.g., usage, throughput).

read_only.description: Start master in read-only mode (useful for maintenance or disaster recovery).

quota_support.description: Enable or disable POSIX-style quota enforcement for directories.

exports_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between periodic full metadata exports (snapshots).

chunkservers.description: List of chunkservers to register with the master. Each entry must include a hostname and unique numeric ID.

hostname.description: Fully-qualified hostname or IP address of the chunkserver.

id.description: Numeric ID (1–65535) uniquely identifying this chunkserver.

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames/IPs for client connections (e.g., ['*.internal', '10.0.0.0/8']). Empty list = allow all.

allowed_metalogger_hosts.description: List of allowed hosts for metalogger connections. Empty list = allow all.

allowed_chunkserver_hosts.description: List of allowed hosts for chunkserver connections. Empty list = allow all.
